# Fresh review of T-045 (branch agent/claude/T-045-decisions-25-oct)

Reviewer: a fresh Claude subagent without the implementer's context. `bun run check` passed (238/238 at review time, 240/240 after fixes).

Verdict: nothing serious. No privilege escalation (no INSERT policy on `members`, UPDATE granted only on name, phone and branch; `accounts` has no UPDATE policy; `accept_invitation` maps OWNER to ADMIN), no way around the six-month rule, every app role check accepts OWNER, the Home tile and Settle debts read the same netted suggestions.

| #   | Severity | Finding                                                                                                                                                       | Done                                                                                                                                        |
| --- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Medium   | An account could end up without an owner who can sign in (an OWNER row without a sign-in; no admin with a sign-in at backfill; owner's sign-in deleted later) | Backfill demotes sign-in-less OWNER rows; trigger promotes the next admin with a sign-in on insert or update; check query in the task brief |
| 2   | Low      | Organisation → family leaves pending stay requests nobody sees                                                                                                | `change_account_type` refuses with `pending_requests`                                                                                       |
| 3   | Low      | Export shows members an empty requests list                                                                                                                   | Export is admin-only for members' view                                                                                                      |
| 4   | Low      | Notifications queries requests for members                                                                                                                    | Gated on admin                                                                                                                              |
| 5   | Low      | D-30 offer can create duplicate invitations                                                                                                                   | Offer skipped for existing members and pending invitations                                                                                  |
| 6   | Info     | Live analytics server function is public                                                                                                                      | Accepted: aggregate output, 6 h cache                                                                                                       |

Not verified: 0036 on the real database, HEIC at runtime in the app, GA4 against Google.
